description: This Java interface defines a visitor pattern for traversing JSON data structures, supporting different JSON value types including null, boolean, string, number, array, and object. It includes methods to handle each type and a default eval method to process a JsonValue instance recursively.

classes.name: JsonInternalVisitor
classes.description: A package-private interface implementing the visitor pattern to process JSON data structures. Supports handling of null, boolean, string, number, array, and object types, with a default eval method to recursively process JsonValue instances.

methods.name: nullValue
methods.description: Returns a value representing JSON null.

methods.name: array
methods.description: Processes a JSON array of values.

methods.name: object
methods.description: Processes a JSON object represented as a stream of key-value entries.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Recursively evaluates a JsonValue, dispatching to the appropriate method based on the value type.
